label: Revived ancient Pyrrhonian skepticism in Renaissance Europe
description: Michel de Montaigne adopted Pyrrho of Elis's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Pyrrho of Elis's perspective to Michel de Montaigne's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Hellenistic & Roman across history into the Early Modern & Scientific.

label: Deep historical convergence between Pyrrhonian epochē (suspension of judgment via the tetralemma) and Madhyamaka prasaṅga rejecting all four positions of the Catuṣkoṭi
description: Nagarjuna synthesized Pyrrho of Elis's framework with contrasting philosophical traditions to produce a novel unified philosophical system.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Pyrrho of Elis's perspective to Nagarjuna's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Hellenistic & Roman across history into the Eastern & Axial Traditions.
